proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: the differentials of the base change identify Omega_{G x_S G/G} with pr_0^* Omega; the shearing automorphism (g, h) -> (m(g, h), h) over G and pr_0 of it being m rewrite this as an isomorphism m^* Omega -> pr_0^* Omega; pulling back along (e of f, id_G) and using m (e f, id) = id and pr_0 (e f, id) = e f gives Omega_{G/S} = f^* e^* Omega_{G/S}; the conormal identification is the immersion-section lemma, and over a field every module on S is free (source lines 869-901)
